text:
ana: kicked off cross-region numeric-profile sweep for nova-13b — fp16/bf16/int8/fp8 across h100 & a100 in us-west1 / europe-west1 / asia-east1. baseline: p50/p95 lat + quality deltas on the internal eval set
chris: nice. which kernel variants are you testing? flash_attn, aten fused, or our custom kv path?      
ana: testing flash_attn_v2, aten_fused, custom_kv_v3. batches 1/4/8, seq 256/1024. running with cache warmup + prefix cache enabled.
sophia: can you paste the run command so infra can replicate?
ana: sure:
```
run_bench --model nova-13b \
  --profiles fp16,bf16,int8,fp8 \
  --gpus h100,a100 \
  --regions us-west1,europe-west1,asia-east1 \
  --kernels flash_attn_v2,aten_fused,custom_kv_v3 \
  --batch-sizes 1,4,8 \
  --seq-len 256,1024 \
  --eval-set redwood-internal-qa-5k \
  --metrics p50,p95,throughput,tokens_per_sec,quality_delta
```
deploy-bot: perf-run triggered for thread 1923456789 (job id perf-2026-1923) :rocket:
chris: preliminary numbers from us-west1 (h100, seq=1024, batch=4):
```
flash_attn_v2 | fp16  | p50=34ms  p95=78ms  tps=9.4k tok/s  qdelta=+0.0%
flash_attn_v2 | int8  | p50=29ms  p95=66ms  tps=12.1k tok/s qdelta=-0.6%
aten_fused    | fp16  | p50=39ms  p95=85ms  tps=8.1k tok/s  qdelta=+0.0%
custom_kv_v3  | fp8   | p50=27ms  p95=60ms  tps=13.6k tok/s qdelta=-0.8%
```
ana: eu-west1 (a100) shows different ordering: aten_fused fp16 p95 is better than flash_attn_v2 for batch=1 workloads
mike: key callouts so far:
- fp8 gives best tokens/sec on h100 but slightly larger quality delta vs fp16 on our QA eval (~0.6-0.9% regress).
- int8 on h100 is a good cost win with small qdelta (~0.4-0.7%) depending on prompts.
- a100 seems more stable for fp16 p95 at small batch sizes; h100 shines at larger batching due to kernel vectorization.
eva: can we get per-prompt failure/regression examples? need to verify catastrophic cases before recommending for dedicated pools.
ana: pulling top-10 regressions now — most are hallucination/formatting edge cases, not core factual failure. attaching snippet of worst-case diffs:
```
input: "Summarize EU privacy law differences in 3 bullets"
fp16: "...GDPR, E-Privacy, national derogations..."
int8: "...GDPR, several country rules... some missing ePrivacy mention"  <- loss of specific term
```
sophia: for Dedicated sizing — rough capacity calc (us-west1 h100 pool):
- target p95 latency budget: 120ms
- observed tokens/s per card (fp16, mixed kernel) ~ 70k tok/s under steady mix -> 700k tok/s for 10 cards
- estimated 95th-percentile concurrent traffic for 1k active users (avg 50 tokens/req) ~ 50k req/min => ~41.6 req/s -> ~2.08M tok/s needed -> ~30 cards (ballpark)
chris: that matches my quick sim, but factor in autoscale headroom + fallback to a100 for cost-sensitive tiers.
ana: also note cache hit rate reduces effective load by ~22% on our chat-like traces — include that in final sizing
deploy-bot: perf-run completed for us-west1 h100 (job id perf-2026-1923) :white_check_mark:
mike: next steps proposal:
- freeze 2 kernel profiles for public hosted: flash_attn_v2(fp16) and custom_kv_v3(fp8) behind a flag for canary customers
- dedicated default: aten_fused(fp16) for small-batch p95 stability
- run expanded eval suite (10k prompts) for fp8 candidate before rollout
eva: agree — add an automated quality gate: any qdelta > 1.0% or regression > 0.2% on critical prompts blocks canary
ana: will push dashboard with per-region p50/p95 and qdelta heatmap + CSV export by EOD
sophia: linking perf plots here: https://internal.redwood/perf/1923456789 (charts: tokens/sec by gpu, p95 by region, qdelta per profile)
chris: thanks team — great run. will sync deeper in tomorrow's eng-ml sync (agenda: pick default kernel & rollout plan). :thumbsup:
